features.title: Provide host-backed client queries
features.summary: Expose one query client per bundle and deliver typed query state to decorated children while preserving readable failures.
failureModes: Query hooks outside the provider fail clearly.
Remote errors without a message use a safe fallback.

features.title: Persist schema-validated client values
features.summary: Read fallback values for missing, malformed, or invalid storage, persist only schema-valid writes, react to other-tab changes, and report unavailable writes without losing in-memory state.
failureModes: Invalid storage is not propagated as a valid value.
Storage denial leaves a usable in-memory value and exposes failure status.

verification.testName: persists valid writes and rejects invalid ones
follows another tab through the storage event
keeps the value in memory and reports false when storage refuses the write

features.title: Compose validated forms and accessible data tables
features.summary: Show schema errors on submit, submit valid form state, sort tables from accessible header buttons, and render empty states across columns.
failureModes: Invalid form values are not submitted.
An empty table preserves its column structure and accessible headers.

verification.testName: shows schema errors after submission and submits valid values
sorts through an accessible header button
renders the empty row across every column

features.title: Debounce fast-changing client input
features.summary: Publish only the final value after the configured delay so search and preference consumers avoid redundant work.
failureModes: A superseded value is never published after the latest value wins.

verification.testName: publishes only the last value after the delay
